title: Planning cases versus execution, later master adoption, issued-item facts and deferred queue ownership
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical plan / integration chronology / static evidence limits
reviews.disposition:
Historical planning owner and retained idea coverage under current AD36/AD43 and authority rules. Preserve G1–G8 and their distinct starts, powers, social life, continuity, engine, material, review and micro concerns. Seven workers covering eight lanes is not eight independent workers; returned G1 also carried G8. The179 cards are proposals, and693 acceptance cases were specified, not run. Structural/peer validation and an implementation queue do not establish runtime implementation, natural acquisition, native play or acceptance of every idea. Full source-book qualification, all396 intake artifacts and every world were explicitly outside this wave's proof.

The native planning ledger, reconciliation, queue, coverage and follow-up gates retain detail/provenance rather than being replaced by a generic archive pointer. Compatible world alternatives are palettes, not shared universal laws. Specific missing consumer/contracts and source questions remain their owners' gaps; merely naming a title/skill/status audit or VFX family does not implement it. The opening live-owner statement, dispatch reservations and agent identities are dated recovery information, not proof of current writers or a present instruction to dispatch. This review reads the whole README, not each linked lane/report/JSON body. Existing later ledgers retain their separately recorded coverage; no new agents, chats, source reading or runtime wave follows from this historical brief.

reviews.classification: historical plan / integration chronology / static evidence limits
reviews.disposition:
Historical integration chronology under AD36/AD41/AD42/AD43. The initial local-only no-push/app boundary was later explicitly superseded by the publication/adoption paragraph and its separate APP_ADOPTION receipt. Preserve both dates/states: the original integration did not publish, while later authority reportedly pushed the named runtime and adopted the named normal build with backed-up byte-identical saves across reload. This review does not independently verify today's remote tip, installed build, profile or save bytes, and grants no present commit, push or adoption action.

Keep the181 selected released paths, two pathway commits, one ritual commit and history-only merge distinct. The559 historical paths reconcile as440 byte matches,109 evolved files,eight retained screenshots andtwo reorganized tests; evolution is not absence and does not warrant restoring the old runtime. The ten dirty-worktree archives preserve1191 changed/untracked files at their original bases; verified archive hashes do not certify gameplay or justify wholesale reapplication. Generated outputs, failed attempts and obsolete MCP/prose snapshots are preserved history rather than automatically pending changes. Contemporary tooling and late source-harvest ownership exclusions remain the original integration boundary, not current reservation proof.

The3214 full-suite pass,60 focused tests and native scenarios are version-bound original evidence. Syntax checks on recovered D1 helpers are not newly exercised journeys. Synthetic tool practice/equipment/cave access and earned HP fixtures differ from natural acquisition. Ritual bench preview remains distinct from a drinkable high-rank transition. Human pacing/taste is optional AD42 review; broader world/source gaps remain outside the combined slice. No linked verification log/archive/native receipt or adoption profile was inspected during this full-checkpoint content review.

reviews.classification: historical plan / integration chronology / static evidence limits
reviews.disposition:
Historical six-intent continuation and incomplete item integration under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve the split arrival/greeting: an arrival act cannot use its own visit as prior participant support. The later issue records held facts/knowledge, not ammunition, badge, holster item ownership or usable custody. Ten and thirty ammunition statements retain their source-window context rather than merging with ch20's dropped-bullets note; TD9 remains the missing operational stock/custody consumer. Open diary/Sequences questions provide later story consumers, not completed inquiry or a closed badge-range request.

Do not give the lead an unheard closing exchange or invent its speaker. Reused rooms/stairs and explicit arrivals do not establish complete schedules. Static preflight warnings about earlier ended visits and the successful native overlap are distinct: this route's no-hang outcome does not solve KJ3E's specific undiagnosed freeze or prove a global two-visit invariant. Four runs plus a read-only probe retain their failures: wrong action location, note/completion-key collision causing early arc completion, and copied-runner typo. A note key matching an act's completion marker is a concrete producer/state collision to check, not a newly implemented lint just because the Next paragraph requests one.

The seeded KJ3H checkpoint, final151-second run, unchanged2883 balance/inventories and literal import support the original bounded continuation. No14/21 px screenshots were taken, so headless native success cannot become visual proof. Civil clock, broad counterfactuals and human play remain untested here. Reader brief/checker plus coordinator reread, approximate reading/authoring/proof timings and five corrected sweep rows are separately attributed; they do not establish PF13 speedup or fresh source reading in this reconciliation. The ch22 handoff remains a historical boundary, not new execution authority.

reviews.classification: historical plan / integration chronology / static evidence limits
reviews.disposition:
Version-qualified static research with unresolved lifecycle ownership, reconciled under AD32 and source/evidence rules. Preserve F1–F4 and Q1's five bounded consumers. Deferred classification uses DestinationZoneID null plus tracking eligibility, unlike destination initialization's null-or-empty condition. Queue removal/inactivation is not death or graveyard registration. Contextless and explicitly tracked actors follow different branches; a player/important actor result cannot establish ordinary queued NPC/item behavior.

Destination resolution conditionally processes Queue and Locations together, ignores individual Teleport Boolean results, logs per-victim exceptions, then clears the collections. An explicit entrant's later veto can coexist with earlier queue processing. A returned ApplyVortex true is not proof of successful landing. Exceptions, invalid/already-contextual entries and missing destinations have distinct fates. The absence of a retry ledger in this method is scoped, not proof that every external owner is absent.

The inherited serializer trace reportedly excludes Queue/Locations/InitialTurn, stronger than attribute inspection alone. Cell traversal cannot serialize an actor removed from that cell, but other referenced roots remain open; serializing a victim elsewhere does not reconstruct the omitted vortex association. No whole-game save-loss claim follows. Temporary expiration, GetContentsEvent-defined contents, teardown/graveyard storage, zone release and final pooling are different routes. A default256 graveyard capacity is a pinned stock detail, not a YAIR storage rule. Blueprint composition is not a complete inherited-hook or mod audit. Pooling the parent does not prove destruction, relocation or refund of earlier victims.

Retain the prioritized questions about global reference traversal, contents/pooling, failed teleport, dynamic parts/mods and unrelated unread families. This review reads the entire public trace, not private decoded classes, line locators, blueprint JSON or native Qud. Static decoded branches are not a reproduced bug or verified native save-loss scenario. No automatic game fix, universal queue design or native research run is authorized by retaining these questions.
